title: JM Die fleet-wide program analysis — G-code time + fair-market-value + inflation adjust
trigger: /goal-15 (2026-05-24) — scan every file, calculate FMV vs charged, inflation-compensate, parse lathe/mill/wedm programs for time-in-cut + run time + op count + per-version JM Die fleet analysis. Self-loop readiness assessment.
leverage_summary: Reuses JM-DIE-FINANCIAL-BASELINE-MS0 pipeline + adds 3 dimensions: program-time analytics + inflation adjustment + FMV gap detection. Extends ingest scope from _PART LIBRARY (10 customers) to full archive root (CNC LATHE / CNC MILL HAAS / OKUMA / HURCO / WIRE EDM / etc.).

units.title: GCodeTimeEstimatorEngine — parses .nc/.min/.mpf/.eia/.iso programs; counts blocks + G01/G02/G03 + M-codes + tool changes; estimates time-in-cut from feed rates
units.acceptance: ≥14 tests; spanning 3 dialects (Fanuc mill, Mazak lathe, Sodick WEDM); time-in-cut returned in seconds; op_count + rapid_count + cutting_count separated; R12 fail-loud on empty/binary input

units.title: InflationAdjustEngine — date → CPI multiplier; adjusts historical USD to today; uses canonical BLS CPI-U seed
units.acceptance: ≥10 tests; BLS CPI-U Jan-2020 to current; lookup(usd, fromDate, toDate) → adjustedUsd + cpiRatio; nearest-prior fallback; R12 fail-loud on out-of-range dates

units.title: FairMarketValueEngine — given {time_in_cut_s, material_spend, machine_rate, overhead} → fmv_usd; compares to charged to compute gap_pct + verdict (under/at/over-charged)
units.acceptance: ≥12 tests; 3 spanning verdict classes; R12 fail-loud on missing inputs; FMV math = (time_h × rate) + material × markup + overhead × (1+margin)

units.title: JMDieFleetWideIngestEngine — wraps U-JM01 to walk all root-level archive dirs (CNC LATHE / CNC MILL HAAS / OKUMA / HURCO / WIRE EDM / _PART LIBRARY / etc.); per-dir machine-family classification
units.acceptance: ≥10 tests; walks ≥6 archive subdirs; classifies each file by machine_family (mill/lathe/wedm/sinker_edm/generic); R12 fail-loud on missing archive root

units.title: prism_quoting dispatcher — 4 new actions (gcode_time_estimate, inflation_adjust, fair_market_value, jm_die_fleet_wide_ingest)

phases.title: End-to-end fleet program analysis + self-loop readiness assessment

units.title: E2E: walks H:/prism/JM DIE/, parses real .nc programs, produces per-program time + per-customer FMV gap + inflation-adjusted totals → JM-DIE-PROGRAM-ANALYSIS-2026-05-24.json
units.acceptance: Runs on real archive; output JSON has ≥1 program analyzed + FMV verdict; R12 fail-loud on missing archive

units.title: Self-loop readiness assessment doc — checklist of {ingest, train, evaluate, deploy} layers + which are wired + which are gap
units.acceptance: Doc names each of 4 layers, status per leg of PSN, explicit gap list for next iter
